title: Social conformity
titleCn: 社会从众心理实验：阿希实验与烟雾实验

paragraphs.text: Asch Conformity Experiment. There is an experiment with 2 cards. One card has a single line, and the other has 3 lines. Respondents are required to choose a line with equal length. Answers vary, and only a 3rd people are correct.
When asked to repeat the experiment with 2 identical cards, most of the people are incorrect in the 2nd time.

Auto-Kinetic Effect Experiment. However, some researchers believe the results are too random. Researchers set up a new website for collecting the questionnaires. People are locked in a dark room to take movement test. John Darley Experiment. The room is infused with smoke, but people show no fear. People tend to copy each other's behavior inside the dark room and take no actions, although they know what to do in case of emergency.
Later on, another research was conducted in a restaurant.
